description: End-to-end task evals for the lynx-tasm-codec skill. These evals measure whether the skill gives the correct Lynx TASM CLI commands, versioning strategy, and install behavior for encode/decode tasks.

evals.name: encode-json-with-subcommand
evals.prompt: 帮我把 `/tmp/card-template.json` 编成 `/tmp/card-template.tasm`。要求直接给 CLI 命令，不要改 package.json，也不要给 Node API 方案。
evals.expected_output: A command using `agent-lynx tasm encode -i /tmp/card-template.json -o /tmp/card-template.tasm`, plus a brief note that the output file path is `/tmp/card-template.tasm`.
expectations: The answer uses `agent-lynx tasm encode` (NOT `decode`, NOT a Node API snippet).
The command passes the exact input path `/tmp/card-template.json` via `-i`.
The command passes the exact output path `/tmp/card-template.tasm` via `-o`.
The answer does NOT suggest `npm i -g` or adding `@lynx-js/tasm` to project dependencies.
The answer explicitly or implicitly indicates the output will be written to `/tmp/card-template.tasm`.

evals.name: decode-with-pinned-version
evals.prompt: 我想固定 `@lynx-js/tasm@0.0.53` 版本，把 `/data/template.tasm` 解码成 `/data/template.json`，给我最直接的命令。
expectations: The answer uses `agent-lynx tasm --codec-version 0.0.53 decode` with the version pinned by --codec-version.
The command passes `/data/template.tasm` via `-i` and `/data/template.json` via `-o`.
The answer does NOT switch to an unpinned global command like `lynx-tasm decode`.
The answer does NOT suggest writing the dependency into package.json.

evals.name: check-cli-without-global-install
evals.prompt: 先别转文件，我只想确认这个 CLI 能不能用，而且不要全局安装。`command -v agent-lynx` 没找到命令，也没有宿主 CLI 入口。你给我一个最小命令就行。
evals.expected_output: A command using `npx --yes --registry https://registry.npmjs.org agent-lynx tasm --help` and no global install recommendation.
expectations: The answer uses `npx --yes --registry https://registry.npmjs.org agent-lynx tasm --help` to verify availability when the CLI is not on PATH.
The answer does NOT suggest a global install because the user explicitly said not to globally install.
The answer does NOT invent a project-local install step such as `pnpm add -D @lynx-js/tasm`.

evals.name: global-install-only-when-requested
evals.prompt: 我就是想用全局命令。请先全局安装 `agent-lynx`，然后把 `/abs/in.json` 编成 `/abs/out.tasm`。
evals.expected_output: A global install command using the npm registry, followed by a `agent-lynx tasm encode -i /abs/in.json -o /abs/out.tasm` command.
expectations: The answer includes `npm i -g agent-lynx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org` (or equivalent with the same package and registry).
After installation, the answer uses the global command form `agent-lynx tasm encode` (NOT `npx @lynx-js/tasm encode`).
The answer still uses the `encode` subcommand and does not switch to `decode`.
